svg.title: The League of Amazing Programmers — comic masthead lockup
svg.desc: Self-contained vector masthead following components/masthead/cover-comic-masthead.png: Trade Gothic Pro Bold (embedded), "AMAZING" on two independent curves (a centered concave top and an asymmetric convex bottom biased so A renders far larger than G), "PROGRAMMERS" riding the exact same bottom curve as a rigid per-column translation (uniform letter size) spanning from under the M to the G, tucked ~10px below AMAZING's ink, and a plain full-width banner (no forked ends) below.

g.text: SMART MINDS · BOLD IDEAS · BRIGHT FUTURES
